threats.name: Drought & Water Shortage
threats.description: Insufficient precipitation or water availability that restricts municipal, industrial or facility water supplies and can impair cooling, fire suppression, sanitation, facility operations or dependent utility services.

threats.name: Earthquakes
threats.description: Sudden ground movement caused by seismic activity that can damage facilities, technology, utilities and transportation infrastructure, disrupt personnel access and impair the operation or recovery of controls.

threats.name: Fire & Wildfires
threats.description: Fire affecting a facility or surrounding area that can injure personnel, destroy or damage technology and records, interrupt utilities and facility access and impair primary or recovery control capabilities.

threats.name: Floods
threats.description: Water intrusion or inundation caused by rainfall, surface water, storm surge, infrastructure failure or other sources that can damage facilities and technology, interrupt utilities and make control-supporting locations inaccessible.

threats.name: Hurricanes & Tropical Storms
threats.description: A hurricane, tropical storm or other tropical cyclone that can produce destructive winds, flooding, storm surge, utility outages, transportation disruption and facility damage that impair control execution or recovery.

threats.name: Landslides & Debris Flow
threats.description: Movement of soil, rock or debris that can damage or isolate facilities, transportation routes, utilities and communications needed to execute or recover controls.

threats.name: Pandemic (Disease) Outbreaks
threats.description: A widespread infectious disease event that can reduce workforce availability, disrupt suppliers and essential services, restrict facility access and degrade the organization's ability to operate, monitor or recover controls.

threats.name: Severe Weather
threats.description: Severe meteorological conditions, including high winds, hail, extreme heat, heavy precipitation or similar events, that can damage facilities or technology, disrupt utilities and transportation, or otherwise degrade control execution.

threats.name: Space Weather
threats.description: Solar or geomagnetic activity that can disrupt satellites, radio communications, navigation, timing services, electrical grids or other technologies on which control execution depends.

threats.name: Thunderstorms & Lightning
threats.description: Thunderstorms or lightning that can cause electrical surges, fires, utility outages, communications disruption or equipment damage that impairs control execution.

threats.name: Tornadoes
threats.description: A tornado or associated severe wind event that can damage facilities, equipment, utilities and transportation infrastructure, endanger personnel and interrupt the operation or recovery of controls.

threats.name: Tsunamis
threats.description: A tsunami or related coastal inundation event that can cause rapid flooding, structural damage, utility disruption, loss of access and widespread damage to control-supporting facilities and infrastructure.

threats.name: Volcanoes
threats.description: Volcanic activity, including eruption, ashfall, lava, gases or related seismic effects, that can damage or contaminate facilities and equipment, disrupt transportation and utilities and impair control execution.

threats.name: Winter Storms & Extreme Cold
threats.description: Snow, ice, freezing temperatures or other severe winter conditions that can interrupt utilities and transportation, damage equipment, restrict personnel access and degrade control execution or recovery.

threats.name: Civil or Political Unrest
threats.description: Civil disturbance, protest activity, political instability or related violence that can restrict personnel or facility access, disrupt transportation and utilities, damage assets, interrupt suppliers or otherwise impair control execution.

threats.name: Malicious Cyber Activity
threats.description: Deliberate malicious cyber activity, including exploitation, malware, credential abuse, denial-of-service, social engineering or other attack techniques, that can disable, bypass, manipulate or otherwise impair controls and their supporting technologies.

threats.name: Hazardous Materials Emergencies
threats.description: An accidental release, spill, leak, fire, explosion or other hazardous-materials event that can endanger personnel, require evacuation, damage facilities or interrupt operations and control-supporting infrastructure.

threats.name: Nuclear, Biological and Chemical (NBC) Weapons
threats.description: Intentional use or release of chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear agents that can cause casualties, contamination, evacuation, infrastructure disruption and prolonged loss of access to facilities or resources needed for control execution.

threats.name: Physical Crime
threats.description: Physical criminal activity that results in unauthorized entry, theft, vandalism, sabotage or damage to facilities, equipment, records or other assets needed for control execution.

threats.name: Terrorism & Armed Attacks
threats.description: Terrorist activity, active-assailant events or other armed attacks that can cause casualties, facility damage, evacuation, loss of access, infrastructure disruption or interruption of control-supporting operations.

threats.name: Utility Service Disruption
threats.description: Sustained or material loss or degradation of electricity, water, natural gas, telecommunications, internet connectivity or other utility services required to operate facilities, technologies or controls.

threats.name: Dysfunctional Management Practices
threats.description: Management interference, direction, override or other intentional circumventions that prevents established controls from being performed, enforced, monitored or escalated as designed.

threats.name: Human Error
threats.description: Unintentional action or omission by personnel, contractors or other authorized users that misconfigures, disables, bypasses, damages or otherwise impairs a control or its supporting technology, process or data.

threats.name: Technical / Mechanical Failure
threats.description: Non-malicious failure, degradation or malfunction of hardware, software, communications, mechanical equipment or supporting infrastructure that causes a control to become unavailable, unreliable or ineffective.

threats.name: Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change
threats.description: A change in applicable laws, regulations, government directives or contractual obligations that invalidates existing assumptions, requires different safeguards, restricts technologies or suppliers, or otherwise causes established controls to become insufficient or inoperable.

threats.name: Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning
threats.description: Use or introduction of inaccurate, stale, corrupted, incomplete, manipulated or otherwise untrustworthy data that causes controls, analytics or automated decisions to operate incorrectly or ineffectively.

threats.name: Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior
threats.description: Non-malicious failure, malfunction, hallucination, unsafe output, goal misalignment, unintended autonomous action or other erroneous behavior by Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies that impairs a control or dependent business process.

threats.name: Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct
threats.description: Intentional criminal or corrupt conduct by an insider, third party or other actor that can bypass, manipulate or disable controls (e.g., fraud, bribery, theft, embezzlement, extortion or deliberate policy circumvention).

threats.name: Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct
threats.description: A Conflict of Interest (COI) or improper influence that causes a person with authority or access to make biased decisions, circumvent safeguards, conceal issues or otherwise impair objective control execution.

threats.name: Economic Shock / Market Disruption
threats.description: Material economic instability, recession, inflation, interest-rate or exchange-rate shocks, commodity volatility or similar macroeconomic conditions that disrupt staffing, suppliers, investment or resources needed to sustain control execution.

threats.name: Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI)
threats.description: Foreign Ownership, Control or Influence (FOCI) that is used to shape decisions, compel access, redirect operations or obtain sensitive information in a manner that can bypass or undermine organizational or supply-chain controls.

threats.name: Geopolitical Conflict / Government Intervention
threats.description: Political conflict, government intervention, war, civil instability, nationalization, export restriction or other geopolitical action that disrupts suppliers, infrastructure, communications, access or resources required for control execution.

threats.name: Sanctions / Trade Restriction Disruption
threats.description: Imposition, expansion or enforcement of sanctions, export controls, exclusions or trade restrictions that removes or constrains access to suppliers, technologies, services, personnel or financial channels required for control execution.

threats.name: Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Products
threats.description: Counterfeit, substituted, defective or non-conforming components, materials, software or services enter the supply chain and cause control-supporting products to perform unpredictably, fail prematurely or operate outside required specifications.

threats.name: Hazardous / Degraded Operational Environment
threats.description: Environmental, physical or operating conditions at the place of performance that exceed design assumptions or safe operating limits and degrade personnel, equipment or processes needed for control execution.

threats.name: Manufacturing Capacity / Supply Disruption
threats.description: Loss, reduction or delay of manufacturing capacity, materials, components or supplier output that prevents timely availability of products or services required for control execution (e.g., sole-source or concentration failures).

threats.name: Product Defect / Design Failure
threats.description: A design flaw, manufacturing defect, quality failure or specification deviation in a product or service that causes unsafe, unreliable or ineffective operation of a control or its supporting technology.

threats.name: Supplier Financial Distress / Insolvency
threats.description: Financial distress, loss of liquidity, hostile acquisition, bankruptcy or insolvency of a critical supplier that interrupts contractual performance, support, maintenance or delivery of control-dependent products or services.

threats.name: Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption
threats.description: Loss, shortage, unavailability or labor disruption of personnel with required knowledge, skills or authorization that prevents controls from being performed, maintained, monitored or recovered as intended.

threats.name: Transportation / Logistics Disruption
threats.description: Accident, cargo loss, carrier failure, route closure, capacity shortage or other transportation or logistics disruption that delays or prevents delivery of products, equipment or services needed for control execution.

threats.name: Infrastructure Failure / Degradation
threats.description: Failure, degradation or unavailability of transportation, communications, energy, facilities or other foundational infrastructure on which the organization or its supply chain depends for control execution.

threats.name: Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL)
threats.description: A threat actor intercepts and retains currently encrypted sensitive information with the intent to decrypt it later when cryptanalytic or quantum capabilities make the deployed cryptography vulnerable.

threats.name: Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack
threats.description: Deliberate manipulation or exploitation of an AI system through adversarial inputs, prompt injection, jailbreaking, data or model poisoning, model theft, inference attacks or related techniques that bypass, alter or impair controls or AI-dependent functions.

threats.name: Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Control System (ICS) Attack
threats.description: Deliberate cyberattack against Operational Technology (OT) or Industrial Control System (ICS) environments that manipulates, disrupts or disables industrial processes, safety functions, equipment or control-supporting operations.

threats.name: Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement
threats.description: Advances in computing, cryptanalysis or attack techniques reduce the effective security of deployed cryptographic algorithms or key sizes, causing cryptographic controls to provide less protection than intended.
